headline: 9 Solana accounts catalogued across 1 chain (stake pool, token mint, manager/staker, authorities, validator list, fee account, reserve stake, SPL program); GitHub and deployed-contracts doc not located.

findings.text: D1: Solana has no canonical EVM block-explorer name-tag search. Used Solscan (solscan.io) — confirmed stake pool account StKeDUdSu7jMSnPJ1MPqDnk3RdEwD2QbJaisHMebGhw exists on-chain. Solana Compass (third-party analytics) provided a full address book for this pool including manager, staker, authorities, validator list, pool mint, fee account, and reserve stake.

D2: Protocol website app.solstrategies.io returned a JavaScript SPA shell with no embedded address list. solstrategies.io press releases and blog confirm SPL Stake Pool Program usage but do not publish a dedicated deployed-contracts page. No canonical deployments doc URL found; protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: The audit link (https://www.solana-program.com/docs/stake-pool#security-audits) points to audits of the shared SPL Stake Pool Program (SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy) — not a STKESOL-specific audit. Nine audits found: Quantstamp (2021-10), Neodyme (2021-10, 2022-12, 2023-01, 2023-11), Kudelski (2021-07), OtterSec (2023-01), Halborn (2023-01, 2023-12). No STKESOL-specific audit scope table found; all addresses noted are audit-era for the program, not the pool instance.

D4: protocol.github listed as 'SOL-Strategies' (org name only). Direct fetch of https://github.com/SOL-Strategies was rejected (URL not in prior search/fetch results). No deployment artifacts, broadcast files, or address indexes located. GitHub content remains unverified.
D5: Protocol operates on Solana only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: The SPL Stake Pool Program (SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy) is a shared factory-like program. STKESOL's specific pool instance is StKeDUdSu7jMSnPJ1MPqDnk3RdEwD2QbJaisHMebGhw. As of epoch 1027, the pool stakes to 71 active validators. Validator stake accounts are ephemeral delegation targets managed by the off-chain delegation bot; they are not enumerated here (>50 cap would apply, and they change each epoch).

D7: Role taxonomy applied to all 9 accounts. Manager/Staker address is the same key (stker2jR6XibQZ3yT5xgEe4fYS5yHR1ZFVUj5fm7i1G) — actor_class unknown (Solana base58; bytecode not verified this run). SPL Stake Pool Program is an immutable on-chain program maintained by Solana Foundation/Anza.

D8: All 9 addresses trace to the Solana Compass fetch of https://solanacompass.com/stake-pools/StKeDUdSu7jMSnPJ1MPqDnk3RdEwD2QbJaisHMebGhw (evidence index 4). Stake pool account additionally confirmed by Solscan fetch. No snippet-only sightings without a corroborating full-page fetch.

rationale.verdict: Walked solstrategies.io press releases and blog, Solana Compass stake pool page, Solscan, and the SPL Stake Pool audit page. Catalogued 9 Solana accounts: the pool state account, pool token mint, manager/staker authority, stake deposit authority, pool withdraw authority, validator list storage account, manager fee account, reserve stake account, and the shared SPL Stake Pool Program. GitHub repo content and a dedicated deployed-contracts doc were not located, so grade remains unknown per discovery slice rules.

protocol_metadata.about: STKESOL is a liquid staking token (LST) issued by SOL Strategies Inc. (NASDAQ: STKE), a Canadian publicly traded company. Users deposit SOL and receive STKESOL, a receipt token whose exchange rate grows as the underlying staked SOL earns rewards. The protocol uses the audited, shared SPL Stake Pool Program (SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy) and delegates stake across 71+ validators algorithmically selected by SOL Strategies' proprietary Wiz Score methodology from stakewiz.com. STKESOL can be held, traded on DEXs (Orca, Jupiter), used as collateral (Kamino, Loopscale), or deployed in DeFi strategies, with a 5% rewards fee and 0.10% withdrawal fee.
